title: xApocalypse
description: A brutal, customizable zombie apocalypse plugin for survival servers
body:
📋 Text version (full banner) **xAPOCALYPSE** A brutal, customizable zombie apocalypse plugin. **WHAT IS XAPOCALYPSE?** Transform your survival world into a brutal wasteland. xApocalypse delivers advanced zombie AI, relentless mechanics, and total customisation to forge the ultimate survival experience. **MORE THAN 15 ZOMBIE TYPES** Ditch predictable vanilla mobs. Face a terrifying roster of unique infected — from lightning-fast sprinters to massive bosses that smash defenses. **BLOODMOONS** When the sky turns red, the nightmare begins. Surges of aggressive hordes and high-intensity world events test your ultimate survival limits. **SUPER CONFIGURABLE** Almost every feature you encounter will be adjustable to your needs. **IMMUNITY** Consume Zombie Guts to temporarily be ignored by all Zombies! Beware, as your health will be decreased. **THERE'S MORE!** Whether it's plugin support or just wanting to hang out with people like you, we have always got a spot in our Discord server!

⚠️ Found a bug or need help? Join our Discord for support — please don't leave a negative review without reaching out first.
